    Detecting the tensor boundary by free-group coefficients #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FreeGroupCoefficients.injective_boundary {ι : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [Field k] {D : Type u_3} [DivisionRing D] [Algebra k D] (c : FreeGroup ι → D →ₗ[k] k) (hf : ∀ (z : FreeGroup ι) (u v : D), Function.HasFiniteSupport fun (w : FreeGroup ι) => (c (z * w⁻¹)) u * (c w) v) [Fintype ι] (a : ι → D) (hc : ∀ (u : D), (∀ (g : FreeGroup ι), (c g) u = 0) → u = 0) (left : ∀ (i : ι) (w : FreeGroup ι) (v : D), (c w) (a i * v) = (c ((FreeGroup.of i)⁻¹ * w)) v) (right : ∀ (i : ι) (w : FreeGroup ι) (v : D), (c w) (v * a i) = (c (w * (FreeGroup.of i)⁻¹)) v) :
    Function.Injective ⇑(freeTensorBoundary k a)

    Suppose elements of D have separating free-group coefficients for which products have finite supports on each multiplication fiber. If the designated elements translate coefficients on the left and right, their tensor boundary is injective.
